title: Magically Engraved
description: Bridges the gap between modern Minecraft tech and ancient magic. Use your life-force to change reality.
body:
# ✨ Magically Engraved **Vanilla Redstone Meets High-Tier Sorcery.** Have you ever looked at vanilla Minecraft’s redstone mechanics and thought, *"What if this could rewrite reality?"* **Magically Engraved** bridges the gap between mechanical automation and primordial magic. It introduces a completely custom, seamless **Redstone-Driven Block State Array Intercept Engine** that allows vanilla Crafters to act as dynamic focal points for manufacturing reality-warping magical artifacts. No massive resource packs required, no foreign tech stacks—just pure, lightweight data-driven spellcasting. --- ## ⚡ Core Mechanics & Gameplay Loops ### 🔮 The Intercept Engine Forget basic crafting grids. When a vanilla Crafter is powered while configured into a specific geometric item array, the engine intercepts the execution vector. If a player stands within 5 meters and sacrifices their spiritual essence (Experience Levels or Raw Points), the materials are consumed, triggering high-end auditory feedback, custom particle matrices, and manifesting a legendary artifact. ### ⚠️ A Warning on Cosmic Stability (Important!) Because you are channeling volatile forces through a mechanical medium, **you must place exactly one single item into each designated interface slot.** The fabric of reality here is incredibly fragile; stacking items inside the manufacturing array will cause the geometric resonance to collapse, preventing the intercept engine from recognizing the spell profile. Respect the matrix, or the magic remains dormant. ### ❌ Zero-Wasted Failure Mechanics Lacking the necessary experience to forge an item? The engine gracefully prevents item destruction, sounding a heavy mechanical failure tone, emitting dynamic cloud arrays, and printing a clear, vivid red action-bar warning directly to your HUD outlining the exact spiritual cost required. --- ## 🛡️ The Forged Arsenal & Spell Profiles Discover 11 legendary relics, each with custom components, specialized casting behaviors, independent tick cooldowns, and powerful impact profiles: * **Chiseled Amethyst Focus:** Releases a radial sonic boom that launches nearby entities skyward while dealing heavy magic damage. * **Engraved Quartz Tablet:** Grants prolonged fire resistance while blanketing the localized coordinate grid in a raging firestorm. * **Engraved Glacial Cube:** Roots the caster in place while locking all surrounding hostile entities within a 7-block stasis cage. * **Mummified Flesh:** Blinds your vision to bestow near-immortal regenerative recovery and defensive shielding. * **Glistening Dust:** Drops invisible, fully structural light blocks (`light_level=15`) directly into empty space at eye level. * **Echoing Echo-Shard:** Launches you into the air with complete fall damage immunity while detonating a Warden-tier sonic shockwave directly beneath you. * **Engraved Obsidian Core:** Anchors your feet to the earth to create a localized singularity, pulling all surrounding entities straight toward you. * **Fermented Spore Pod:** Deploys a thick toxic cloud that cloaks you in true invisibility while suffocating and blinding invaders. * **Petrified Heart:** Channels the crushing barometric weight of the deep sea to drown and exhaust any target caught in its presence. * **Conductive Copper Rod:** Intercepts active storm vectors to redirect raw lightning bolts straight down upon the nearest hostile target. * **Phantom Membrane Quill:** Defies traditional gravity parameters, letting you handshake perfectly from a sharp levitation launch into a long, smooth glide vector. --- ## 🏆 Integrated Progression Architecture This pack includes a fully customized, backend-driven advancement tree built directly into the vanilla UI notification system. Track your ascendancy across **13 unique progression milestones**, earning massive experience rewards as you learn to automate your sorcery, survive near-fatal casts, and master the entire magical arsenal. Complete them all to unlock the ultimate title: **Arch-Mage of the Crafter**. --- ## 📂 Technical Specifications & Development Manifest For a comprehensive breakdown of the internal registries, tracking stats, exact recipe configurations, and advancement parameters, expand the technical manifest below:
